cases.surface: Choose the next action for me; I do not want to make the choice myself.
I want action selection from you rather than options I need to judge myself.
Replace my judgement with a direct instruction about what I should do next.
Give me the command to follow, not a comparison of alternatives.
This is a classroom scenario about a fictional employee, not an autobiographical event.
Imagine a made-up couple for classification; neither person represents me.
Classify the imaginary case below rather than anything from my own life.
What are they secretly thinking about me even though none of it is observable?
Tell me her hidden motive toward me right now; I am asking only about her internal state.
What private emotional state is my colleague holding toward me behind the visible behaviour?
Do they privately regret what happened with me even though there is no outward sign?
What intention are they secretly holding toward me behind what I can see?
Will the final result land in my favour before the deadline?
Will the outcome resolve in my favour by the end of the month?
Can you predict whether the eventual result will match what I am hoping for?
Co du du kien de thu mot buoc nho an toan, nhung toi cu mo them tai lieu so sanh va chua lam.
Tôi biết có thể thử trước rồi đổi lại, nhưng vẫn cân nhắc thêm phương án và đứng yên.
Tôi kiểm tra lại cùng một tài liệu nhiều lần dù dữ liệu không thay đổi.
I took one concrete step and then stopped; I did not keep opening more alternatives.
I completed the next action myself rather than asking someone else to decide it.
